Human production authorization remains separate from technical verification
Mirror cannot deploy canonical production
Protected/default/open-PR branches are never deleted
Unknown or unique history is retained
Destructive apply is revalidated against live Git state
Repository evidence retains provenance
Learning does not self-promote to Certified Memory
Optimization candidates require review before canonical adoption
No credentials are committed
Provider endpoints remain explicitly configured
Hosted or local inference never becomes DataNest identity authority
Migration lineage is preserved
RLS/authorization impact is reviewed
Rollback or recovery implications are documented
Canonical and Mirror authority remain distinct
Unclassified paths fail closed
FREETREE remains outside all synchronization paths
Relevant tests remain reproducible
Advisory evidence is not mislabeled as certification
Purpose and affected behavior are identifiable
Relevant tests or an explicit evidence rationale accompany the change
The change does not silently escalate production, data, synchronization, or AI authority
Human override and review paths remain available where the change is consequential
BOTSQUAD output remains advisory and traceable to inputs
AI agents cannot approve, merge, deploy production, weaken governance, or make binding commercial commitments
Canonical source adoption remains human-reviewed
Automatic adaptation is limited to generated compatibility state and non-authorizing feeds
Runtime, provider, backend, permission, production-workflow, Forge-authority, and credential changes require human review
FREETREE remains isolated from automatic synchronization
ENFORCER consumes the complete approved Knowledge corpus without category or topic filtering

Autonomous branch deletion is limited to branches proven to have zero unique commits with live revalidation

Behavioral deduplication and refactoring are review-only

FREETREE remains outside automatic orchestration
Suggestions remain attributable to evidence sources and deduplicated
Autonomous commands are limited to predefined reversible maintenance actions
Behavioral, dependency, provider, governance, UI, function, product and business changes remain review-required

hardRules.message: FREETREE must remain isolated from canonical and Mirror synchronization.
Scheduled maintenance may delete only branches proven to have no unique commits; archived unique history requires separate explicit authorization.
Vercel is not a required DataNest delivery dependency.
BOTSQUAD and Forge specialized-tree projections cannot assert production authority.
ENFORCER may enforce checks but cannot acquire production authority, rewrite Boundaries, or suppress findings.
GUARDIAN may heal proven redundancy but cannot gain production authority, delete unique history, or synchronize FREETREE.
CONDUCTOR and SUGGESTER may coordinate and suggest but cannot acquire production/governance authority or synchronize FREETREE.

resultSemantics.pass: No hard boundary violation detected; required human/evidence acceptance still applies.
resultSemantics.review: A change touches a governed scope and requires the listed acceptance evidence.
resultSemantics.block: A machine-verifiable DataNest invariant was violated.
